changelog:
DriveFight 0.16.0 — playability and friends update

- More predictable air response, landings and contact-aware self-righting, with collision checks during recovery.
- Trick names and points live at the top of the screen, fade when idle, and stay separate from match objectives. Menus, controls and statistics are clearer.
- Offline Capture the Flag recovers unreachable flags and escaped carriers while preserving valid elevated routes.
- Roof turrets aim more consistently on tilted cars, separate recoil from projectile origin, and respect close cover.
- Friends flow, reconnect/offline recovery, and online Soccer ball, score, clock and restart behavior are improved.
- Restored authored sound feedback and the optional Block Fort comparison and live-tuning labs. Floating Block Fort sponsor dressing is corrected.

Matching Mac, Windows and Linux server builds use protocol 8. Arena Battle and Soccer support online play; Training Survival and Capture the Flag remain offline. Internet access outside the existing Tailscale group is unchanged.

Source implementation: 7a40afb73cf90dc955ee8822f725b78b698dc1be.
